payload.name: PDF Under 5MB Upload Fix by PrintableTools Lab
payload.short_description: Free no-signup PDF compressor for 5MB upload limits with an optional USD 9 upload fix-plan request.
payload.long_description: A free browser-based PDF under 5MB upload fixer for scanned documents, school forms, application portals, admin uploads, and email-style PDF size errors. It points to local PDF compression, requires no account and no server file upload, and includes an optional USD 9 manual Upload Limit Fix Plan request only after a public-safe fit check.
